text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало and I are making our way back
to the
academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hey, um...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Well, I had a wonderful and productive
time
today, completely befitting a
first-rate
Umamusume such as myself...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
But doesn't it feel a little early to go
back to the
academy? It's still so bright
outside.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Since we're already out and about, why
don't we
stroll around a little more?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: Sure. Where would you like to go?

text_block_list.text: Where? I mean, anywhere is fine...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Actually, you decide our destination!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
A trainer worthy of me must have an
exhaustive
list of first-rate spots!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Now, entertain your king!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
A fast food restaurant... Well, it's not
like I hate
them...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
But is this what you consider a first-rate
spot fit
for me?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list:
I thought you might be tired from walking
around.

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, all right. I suppose I'll have some
iced tea.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
In the meantime, you should think about
our next
destination.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
We still have plenty of time. Think of
more
first-rate places fit for me.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Karaoke seems like an easy way to kill
time, but...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Do you think karaoke is first-rate?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list:
It's first-rate to practice for your winning
concert!

text_block_list.text: Oh, of course! Ohohoho!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Which means you're confident that I'll
win the
race!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's practice! Just imagine me
standing
right in the center of the stage!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
And while you're at it, think about where
we're
going after this!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Your next first-rate place is... your
office?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Is our excursion all finished, then? Are
you
throwing in the towel?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list:
I thought we might discuss our strategy for your
next race.

text_block_list.text: Ah, I should have guessed!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, not bad! Let's come up with a
plan to get
me over the finish line first!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Phew... Oh, when did it get so dark
outside? We
must have been really
focused.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Which means you managed to take me
around
places fit for me...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, all your spots were first-rate! You
pass,
Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Honestly speaking, every one of those
places was
completely ordinary.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
But you chose each location with me in
mind,
which is truly commendable!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Well done, Trainer! I suppose I can allow
you to
take pride in your achievement...
just for today!
Ohohoho!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: Leave the destinations to me from now on!

text_block_list.text:
Well done, Trainer! I suppose I can allow
you to
take pride in your achievement...
just for today!
Ohohoho!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: Leave the destinations to me from now on!

text_block_list.text:
That's what I like to hear! Keep at it, and
I think
we can challenge ourselves to
even greater
heights.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
From now on, all of my breaks will be
completely
up to you. Continue taking
me to first-rate spots!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
In return, I will take you with me on the
path of
glory! Ohohoho!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Excuse me?! I'm always amenable!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I swear... It seems your ability to take a

compliment is still second-rate at best.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
So be it. I'll just have to work even
harder to
make you a first-rate trainer.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
So make sure to watch my every move
and learn
what it truly means to be
first-rate! Ohohoho!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I did say "just for today." Don't let
it go to
your head.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: One must always strive to build on previous efforts! Even I can't afford to become complacent.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Let's rise together to become the
first-rate of the
first-rate! Ohohoho!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало and I laugh together as we
aim for
greater heights.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so, my journey to becoming a
trainer worthy
of Кинг Хало continues.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It feels like Кинг Хало and I have grown
to trust
each other even more.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
